title: This note was just changed somewhere else
body: You have unsaved changes, and the file on disk changed too. Choose which version to keep. Whatever you choose, nothing is lost.
titleDeleted: This note was deleted somewhere else
bodyDeleted: The file is no longer on disk, but what you were writing is kept.

hints.reload: Reload: open the version on disk; yours is set aside as a draft in the browser.
hints.keepMine: Keep my version: save yours; the version on disk goes to the trash.
hints.reloadDeleted: Reload: close your version (still set aside in the browser); the note stays deleted.
hints.keepMineDeleted: Keep my version: create the note again with your text.

versions.label: Versions
versions.baseUnknown: The original is unknown: this draft was written on an older version.
versions.diskDeleted: The file was deleted from disk.
versions.diskNotText: The version on disk cannot be read as text (it is not UTF-8).

diff.title: Compare the version on disk with yours
diff.noChanges: Both versions are the same line by line (only line endings differ).

kept.title: Version set aside on reload
kept.body: This is your version, set aside when you chose Reload. You can restore it (the version on disk goes to the trash) or let it go.
kept.discardBody: This version will be gone for good. The note stays as it is on disk.
